general_changes: Featherless model-detail readiness before new Forge generation/repair, with identity and cache validation
Explicit unavailable-model responses pause with source/build checkpoints retained, not an endless waiting state
Read-only availability recheck; no silent provider/model switch or automatic replay of uncertain paid requests
Pre-submission XML and resolvable local launcher-resource checks with debug/release source sets, aliases, density folders and BOM support
Bounded checkpointed source-validation repair; actual compiler result remains authoritative
Clear saved-project versus current-file-pass counters, separate compiler and resume counts, paused-time wording and stale-question handling
verification_scope: Only the Vanta Android client was modified, compiled, installed and exercised.
Provider/model/build-worker traffic in tests used neutral isolated fixtures, not paid live accounts.
No individual user-generated project was modified, submitted or built.
No separate generated application was compiled or installed in this update run.
Standard client debug/release emulator installs used a disposable QA certificate; delivered standard payload matches tested release.
Both owner-signed APKs passed signature, manifest/DEX, archive-integrity and compiled-payload checks.
No cross-version installation test was performed; package/certificate compatibility was checked against 0.9.0 and storage/key identities were unchanged.
Home, another app, screen-off, network recovery, concurrency and force-stop/relaunch scenarios were exercised with controlled client work.
Physical phone and live model output/build-repair quality remain unverified.
External Android worker, Windows endpoint, desktop code and local inference infrastructure were not modified.
